notes.title: 《Tranquil Night: Legend of the End》PC Version Now on Steam!​(2025.6.16)
notes.notes:
《Tranquil Night: Legend of the End》PC Version Now on Steam!​​

​​Story​​
Dark dust falls from the sky over an otherworldly continent, destroying villages and towns. You awaken with amnesia in the Merlin Mountains and must explore the land to uncover the truth. Though the journey is perilous, you’ll gain allies along the way.

​​Timeline​​

​​Oct 15, 2024:​​ Android version launched. Began iterative testing, bug fixes, and optimizations. Special thanks to veteran players for their time and patience despite critical bugs.

​​May 9, 2025:​​ Mobile version updated with multilingual support.

​​June 16, 2025:​​ PC version launches on Steam (today!).

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3714410/_/"][/dynamiclink]



​​PC​​

​​PC:​​ Priced at $1.5~. Supports controllers/keyboard & mouse.

​​Playtime:​​ ~5 hours (no in-app purchases).

​​Development Notes​​
Inspired by classics like Contra, we aimed for minimalist gameplay, rich storytelling, and hand-drawn 2D art. Current content is lighter than envisioned, but ​​major updates are planned​​:

​​Immediate:​​ Player feedback fixes.

​​October 2025:​​ Overhaul adding story depth and ARPG mechanics (e.g., skill trees, gear systems).

​​

​​Studio:​​ Heart of Xiang Night
